instructions: This repository is Muster's public, append-only history of daily signed anchors and the public anchor keys. Only Muster's anchor job writes to it. Its value is that nobody can quietly rewrite it.

rules.rule: Existing files under anchors/ must never be modified, renamed or deleted; only new days may be added as anchors/<yyyy>/<yyyy-mm-dd>.json. Each new file's prev_anchor_sha256 must name the previous day's file, and no day may be skipped (days with no entries are anchored too).
keys/anchor-keys.json holds public EC P-256 JWKs only (kty, crv, x, y). Flag any private component (d), any other secret, or a key_id that is not the RFC 7638 thumbprint of its JWK.
Retired keys are marked retired, never removed, so older anchors still verify. Flag deletion of any key entry or a change to an existing key's jwk.
